remarks: New to Market - Stunning Updated 1 Bedroom, 1 Bath with the charm of a cozy country cottage nestled in the woods with it's own yard. Step into this beautifully renovated home, offering a fresh and modern feel from top to bottom. Rarely available in Stamford, this one-bedroom gem boasts its very own fenced-in, oversized backyard-perfect for grilling, entertaining, or simply unwinding in your private outdoor retreat with the pup. Inside, you'll love the huge open-concept living and dining area, ideal for both relaxing and hosting. A full-size, in-unit washer and dryer provide everyday convenience, while thoughtful updates throughout create a bright and welcoming atmosphere. Location is everything-and this property delivers. Just minutes to the Merritt Parkway and I-95, with quick access to shopping, banking, and some of the best dining spots in town. Additional highlights include Off-street parking and a spacious layout with abundant closet and cabinet storage. Don't miss this rare opportunity for comfort, convenience, and style-all with room to roam! Please note: There is a $150 monthly utility charge that includes heat, electricity, water, hot water, and even WiFi.
